instruction.text: Über welchen Poster-Entwurf wird gesprochen? Wähle aus.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f4_chirp'>Hey Ethan, thanks for joining today's meeting. As you  know, this year we decided to turn down the idea of girls day in favour of a career day for all students, where there will still be extra seminars where girls can explore typical male-dominated jobs. Let's have a look at the first draft of the poster, shall we?</voice>

instruction.text: Wähle alle Aussagen aus, die <t-blue>wahr</t-blue> sind.

atoms.a: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m4_chirp'>I think it's a nice start. We might want to choose a lighter background and choose a somewhat clearer structure. Let's improve the design together!</voice>
b: Ethan finds that the poster is finished.
